column1: # Coverage runs (docs/COVERAGE.md). One run per line, tab-separated:
# name, baseline run (- for none), virtual seconds, events for crates/dos/examples/coverage.rs,
# what the action is (- for no events). $P, $SEL, $LAUNCH, $CLIMB and $TARGET are expanded by run.sh.
# A run and its baseline have the same length and the same events up to the action.

column5: Start-up to the first second: set-up overlay, drivers, module loads
The intro sequence up to the start-position menu
Choose 1 (Ross 154): commander set-up, system generation, the cockpit landed at Merlin
Cockpit, landed at Sirocco starport on Merlin, idle
Galactic map: scroll with the arrow keys until Barnard's Star is the target
Galactic map, then F6: system data (orrery of the current system)
Galactic map, then F10: the whole galaxy
Cockpit F7 without clearance: take-off, fined by the station
After saving, F7: the load-commander list
Cockpit landed, idle for 47 s (baseline for the flight runs)
Launch request, then F7: vertical take-off with clearance
After take-off: pitch up (right button and mouse back) and thrust (Enter) out of the atmosphere
While climbing: galactic map, select Barnard's Star, back to the front view
